resolution.note: slice run regenerates the lens before every review attempt (with t-smk6dwt)

title: slice run reviews against a lens from the current brief
body:
Outcome: `krn slice run` regenerates the review lens from the current brief before every review attempt (or refuses when the brief changed after the lens), so review never judges against superseded settled decisions.
Evidence: PR #205 (t-4sesbm3): the lead revised the brief after the brief stage; attempt 1 (prepass) raised two BLOCKING findings that matched only the stale .krn/runs/slice/t-4sesbm3/lens.md; an independent Opus verdict rated both NOT A DEFECT.
Proof: an observer that changes the brief after the brief stage and asserts the lens passed to `krn review` holds the new Settled decisions.
Lead trap: after any brief edit past the brief stage, run `krn brief lens <brief> > .krn/runs/slice/<task>/lens.md` before the review stage.
